meta.name: add-gmail-tool
meta.description: Add Gmail as an MCP tool (read, search, send, label, draft) using OneCLI-managed OAuth. The agent gets Gmail tools in every enabled group; OneCLI injects real tokens at request time so no raw credentials are ever in the container or on disk in usable form.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 MCP 工具读取、搜索、发送和管理 Gmail 邮件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 agent 中通过 MCP 操作 Gmail 邮箱。
copy.tagline_en: Read, search, send, and manage Gmail emails via MCP tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to operate Gmail from an agent via MCP.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会获得一批 Gmail 操作工具（以 mcp__gmail__ 开头），能搜索、读取、发送、草拟邮件，并管理标签和过滤器；真实凭证由 OneCLI 在请求时注入，容器与磁盘上不存明文密钥。
howto.when: 当用户要求让 Claude 连接或使用 Gmail，或要求添加 Gmail 工具时触发。需要由管理员在宿主机器上按流程完成安装。

say.text: 帮我列出我的 Gmail 标签。
say.note: 会调用 Gmail 工具返回标签列表。

say.text: 搜索收件箱里上个月的发票。
say.note: 会按条件搜索匹配的邮件。

say.text: 给李雷草拟一封关于项目进度的邮件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude gains Gmail tools (mcp__gmail__*) to search, read, send, draft emails, and manage labels/filters. Real credentials are injected by OneCLI at request time; no plaintext keys are stored in the container or on disk.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks Claude to connect/use Gmail or to add Gmail tooling. An operator runs the setup steps on the host.

say_en.note: Calls the Gmail tool to fetch labels.

say_en.text: Search my inbox for invoices from last month.
Draft an email to Li Lei about project status.
